title: Unlike the floating Panel itself, it's possible to interact through the gap between the Panel and floating Application launcher and widgets
line: Clicking in the gap between a floating panel's popup and the panel (or the nearby screen edge) no longer clicks the window underneath.
explanation: With floating applets, PopupPlasmaWindow is placed a margin away from the panel and, when constrained, from the screen edges. That gap belongs to no surface, so KWin delivered clicks there to the window below, which also closed the popup. The popup now owns a transparent child surface (Wayland subsurface) whose input region covers exactly those gaps; a press there closes the popup like a click on the panel would, without reaching the window underneath.

commits.message:
plasmaquick/popupplasmawindow: don't let clicks through popup gaps

Floating popups leave a gap towards the panel and the nearby screen
edges, and clicks there reached the window underneath. A transparent
child window now covers those gaps and closes the popup on press.

BUG: 517132

media.caption: Master: Kickoff open (left), click in the gap above the panel (red circle) closes it and reaches the mouse-reporting Konsole behind, which logs the click (right).
Fixed: the same click closes Kickoff but Konsole logs nothing new.
Master: click in the gap between Kickoff and the left screen edge reaches Konsole (new [<0;1;29 lines).
Fixed: the same click no longer reaches Konsole (no new lines).
